## Build Order

1. Authoring contracts (manifest, routing, permissions).
2. DB tenant tables (canonical + extended).
3. Role-profile-as-sole-sync substrate (Wave F1).
4. Test-user fixtures (Wave F2).
5. Activation check 8-cell matrix (Wave F0).
6. RBAC matrix 64-cell (Wave F3).
7. Handover orchestrator (Wave F4).
8. Audit-shelf bundle (Wave F5).
